div.div: Why it's split this way. The TV gets everything live and at full detail. The capture keeps each ingredient separate (camera video with no audio, status logs, the exact print file) so a video can be rebuilt later with different choices: a fuzzier layer panel, and music that is licensed for YouTube. The exact layers (the .goo) are all it takes to reprint the model byte for byte, so they never leave the house.
